svg.title: RB2.1 — DPP super panel 980x430
svg.desc: A 980 by 430 super panel in three zones: a 220 wide tab rail on the left, a 340 wide transparent zone holding the digital model in the middle, and a 420 wide data panel on the right. Locked, unlocked and a second tab are shown.
svg.text: LOCKED — model animates in the middle, no interaction
UNLOCKED — the model detaches; the middle keeps its ghost, the layout does not reflow
340 x 300 · free in the room · grab bar + two-hand gestures
ANOTHER TAB — the model re-reads for that tab · Continue stays locked until all four are visited
980 x 430 BREAKS 00 s.1 "one footprint, always" — the standard must be edited to admit it, not silently violated
FOV: 0.98 m wide at the current 0.6 m placement subtends ~78 deg. Comfortable reading is roughly +/-30 deg,
so the outer thirds sit outside it. Default placement should move to ~0.85-0.9 m (~57 deg) or the panel curves.
The 388 px primary CTA does not fit a 420 column: bottom bar becomes 150 + 210. Primary still right (00 s.5).
Compliance badge moved into the rail — it is global, not per tab, and the right header has no room for it.
Unlocked state does NOT reflow the layout: the middle keeps a ghost outline so no hit target ever moves.
Visited ticks + a locked CTA are how "surf all pages first" is enforced. This is a COMPLETION requirement,
not the RB2.0 confirmation gate that was deleted on 2026-08-01 — different mechanic, different purpose.
